## Description

Briefly describe the change and the motivation behind it.

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor` / `ci` / `docs` / `style` / `test` / `perf` / `build` / `revert`

## Checklist

- [ ] Formatting passes (`pnpm format`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Typecheck passes (`pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] Tests pass (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Build passes (`pnpm build`)
- [ ] Commit message follows `type(scope): subject`

## Content note

New articles are written solely by the owner. Changes to `contents/` in this
PR must be limited to corrections of typos or factual/writing errors.
